column1: # The list of test cases, one per line, that scripts/test.sh draws each tier from.
#   tiers     comma-separated tiers this case belongs to (t1..t4)
#   family    C = controller/device_main, O = basic operation, W = workload
#   check     what a run asserts -- "golden", "stat", or both; free text for now
# t2/t3 rows are commented until the stat-exposing harness lands; test.sh reports
# those tiers as pending rather than passing an empty set.
# t4 runs each through host-run.sh: build the host program, launch the task on
# the simulator, check the answer it wrote back. "golden" must pass; "xfail" is a
# case known to fail today (the reason follows), run anyway so the failure stays
# visible and an [XPASS] flags it the day it starts working.

column4: xfail: fp result rounds ~1e-5 off an exact check

column1: # t2 -- controller / device_main paths. A mojo workload whose device_main
# computes on the controller itself (stack + a non-inlined call) and launches
# nothing. Compiled through the task pipeline and run on Detour's devmain_run;
# asserts launches=0 + load/store traffic + no abort. Self-contained, so there
# is no external buffer and no golden value -- the run's shape is the check.

column4: golden; launches=1; NDP unit active (needs a launch fixture)

column1: # t3 -- basic operations (needs the stat harness):

column4: golden; one vector atomic, spad writes
